teth.definition: n the 9th letter of the Hebrew alphabet
teth.translation: n. 希伯来语的第九个字母(亦作tet)

tether.translation:
n. 系绳, 系链, 界限, 范围
vt. 栓, 束缚, 限制

tetherball.definition: n. a game with two players who use rackets to strike a ball that is tethered to the top of a pole; the object is to wrap the string around the pole

tethered.definition: s. confined or restricted with or as if with a rope or chain
tethered.translation: v. 用绳子拴住（牲畜）( tether的过去式和过去分词 )

tethering.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Tether
tethering.translation: v. 用绳子拴住（牲畜）( tether的现在分词 )

tethers.definition:
n restraint consisting of a rope (or light chain) used to restrain an animal
v tie with a tether
tethers.translation:
n. （拴牲畜用的）系绳( tether的名词复数 ); 系链; （能力等的）限度; 范围
v. 用绳子拴住（牲畜）( tether的第三人称单数 )

tethyan.translation: a. [地](古生代)蒂锡斯海的,古地中海的

tethys.definition:
n (Greek mythology) a Titaness and sea goddess; wife of Oceanus
n type genus of the family Aplysiidae
tethys.translation: 古地中海, 特提斯海
